assessments.reasoning: Authenticity: spdx_detail is json/details/CC0-1.0.json in spdx/license-list-data at 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Integrity: the reported digests match all four cited ranges. Relevance: [16343,16366) gives licenseId, [16293,16340) gives name, [4,35) gives the deprecation flag and [16636,16718) gives seeAlso. Interpretation: the ID is CC0-1.0, the name is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal, the ID is marked nondeprecated and seeAlso names the publisher's legal code. Applicability: spdx_data_tag targets the JSON's exact commit. Contradiction: the JSON's own crossRef URL and spdx_xml [99,337) agree with seeAlso, and the XML ID and name match verbatim.

Authenticity: publisher_readme is the Creative Commons repository README at the inspected plaintext pin. Integrity: the reported [4999,5294) digest matches the citation. Relevance: the Public Domain Tools example gives the publisher's canonical URL and title. Interpretation: zero/1.0/ identifies CC0 1.0 Universal in the publisher's namespace. Applicability: spdx_detail seeAlso appends legalcode to that exact base, and publisher_live supplies the corresponding legalcode.txt. Contradiction: the publisher's title and operative waiver resolve the Public Domain Mark alternative. The README supplies publisher-edition context only.

Authenticity: spdx_xml is src/CC0-1.0.xml in spdx/license-list-XML at b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40. Integrity: its reported [99,337) digest matches the citation. Relevance: the license element contains licenseId, name and crossRef. Interpretation: those fields identify CC0-1.0, Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and the publisher's zero/1.0/legalcode URL. Applicability: spdx_xml_tag targets this XML commit. Contradiction: direct comparison with spdx_detail at its separate data pin finds exact agreement on all three values. The XML's optional text markup limits the comparison to the stated metadata.

Authenticity: spdx_data_tag is the SPDX data repository's Git tag API object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b. Integrity: the reported digest for the complete [0,700) response matches the citation, and the returned tag-object SHA matches the requested object. Relevance: tag, object.type and object.sha supply the release binding. Interpretation: v3.29.0 points directly to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Applicability: that SHA occurs in the spdx_detail URL. Contradiction: spdx_generation returns the same SHA and names build 3.29.0. The unsigned tag supports repository attribution.

Authenticity: spdx_xml_tag is the SPDX XML repository's Git tag API object 7523cc3daa7149e35e2debd7466c1dcb14a84e19. Integrity: the reported complete [0,698) digest matches the citation, and the returned tag-object SHA matches its endpoint. Relevance: tag and target identify the release containing the source XML. Interpretation: v3.29.0 points directly to commit b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40. Applicability: that SHA matches the inspected spdx_xml URL exactly. Contradiction: the annotation also names 3.29.0, and spdx_data_tag assigns the same release name to its own repository's distinct commit. This unsigned object supplies XML release context.

Authenticity: spdx_generation is the original Git commit API record in spdx/license-list-data. Integrity: the reported [0,1237) digest matches the citation, and its sha equals the spdx_data_tag target. Relevance: the commit message reads “License list build 3.29.0 using license list publisher 3.1.4”. Interpretation: it attributes the generated data to that list build and identifies the generator version separately. Applicability: commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 is the exact spdx_detail revision. Contradiction: the build version agrees with both tag names, and the inspected XML fields agree with the generated fields. The message itself supplies no XML input SHA.

limitations: The crosswalk establishes a documentary reference. Text equivalence, copyright classification and grants for individual projects fall outside its scope.
The tag objects and build record share their corresponding SPDX repository lineages. All three report unsigned verification status.

The build message identifies the list and publisher versions but omits the input XML commit SHA. The matching fields and separately tagged XML revision support the documented lineage without proving a reproducible build.
reasoning: At their separately tagged revisions, the SPDX XML and generated JSON agree on CC0-1.0, “Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal” and https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. The publisher identifies that edition under the same canonical namespace. The two annotated tag objects bind v3.29.0 directly to the inspected commits, and the generated-data commit records the 3.29.0 build.
